items.title: Hal Espinosa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 20, 2024
items.q: Warren Luening, the trumpet player... He and I and this other trumpet player, we’d go out and play golf... I was pretty close to him

ctx.x: It’s interesting, I think technology in one respect has been helpful for that kind of thing because you’ve experienced those — except for riding in the Corvette — the endless hours sidemen talk about being on the bus with basically nothing to do. And with the advent of Walkmans and now the phones and everything, people can fill their time with something else that’s not a health risk.
Well even when I was on the bus with Warren Covington and the Tommy Dorsey band, we traveled by bus all the time. We’d play chess — I love playing chess and I found a © Fillius Jazz Archive -17-

few guys that would play. A lot of guys would read. Most of the guys had earphones and were listening to jazz or music of some kind. So we had an opportunity to keep ourselves busy. But when we were on the road there were times after a job you’d get back in the bus either to go to a new place a hundred miles down the road or two hundred, guys would start drinking, turning on, and one time we got to the hotel and one of the guys was on the floor of the bus and he was just out. We had to carry him in the hotel. But…
